turns.replyText:
For the best result:

Assemble it on a clear, flat hard floor. Lay out the numbered pad pieces, connect the interlocking edges until they’re flush, place the rug on top, and tuck the pad into all four corner pockets.

Smooth the cover flat, then gently pull it tight and apply the included corner grippers before placing furniture on it. Small creases usually relax within a week. You can use a low-heat iron if needed.

Use the Tumble Cushioned Rug Pad only. Tumble rugs work best on hard floors. A low-pile, firm carpet may work, but carpet isn’t generally recommended because the rug can feel less stable.

For washing, remove the cover from the pad. Wash the cover cold on a delicate cycle with mild, non-bleach detergent. Don’t use bleach, fabric softener, or dryer sheets. Dry on low heat or air-dry.

Vacuum the pad or wipe it gently with soap and water, then let it dry completely. Lift the rug and clean under the pad about every three months. After a spill, make sure both the pad and floor are completely dry before replacing the rug.

The full assembly guide is here: https://www.tumbleliving.com/pages/assembly
